chapter.heading: The Power of God in His Deliverance of Israel
chapter.v:
When Israel
went out of Egypt,The house of Jacob from a people of strange language,

Judah became
His sanctuary,And Israel His dominion. [Ps. 34:18; [Is. 57:15; 61:1; Matt. 5:3, 4; Luke 18:13, 14] c Ps. 34:18;]

The sea
saw it and fled;Jordan turned back. [Deut. 23:18] [[Is. 1:10-17; 58:1-7; Mic. 6:7, 8]]

The mountains
skipped like rams,The little hills like lambs. [Prov. 1:24; Is. 65:12; Jer. 7:13]

What ails
you, O sea, that you fled?O Jordan, that you turned back? [Ps. 38:20; Is. 60:15; [Luke]

O mountains,
that you skipped like rams?O little hills, like lambs?

Tremble, O
earth, at the presence of the Lord,At the presence of the God of Jacob,

Who turned
the rock into a pool of water,The flint into a fountain of waters.
